cases.title: Navigate to Home — positive

steps.text: Start from a non-home page such as the Login screen.
Click the site name link labeled 'BlogApp' in the top navigation bar.

expected.text: The app navigates to the home page.
The heading '📰 Latest Blog Posts' is visible.
If posts exist, they are shown as cards with a 'Read More →' link on each card. If no posts exist, the message 'No posts available. Be the first to create one!' is visible.

cases.expectedSuccess: The app navigates to the home page. The heading '📰 Latest Blog Posts' is visible. If posts exist, they are shown as cards with a 'Read More →' link on each card. If no posts exist, the message 'No posts available. Be the first to create one!' is visible.

cases.title: Register User — positive

steps.text: Start from the home page.
Click the 'Register' link in the top navigation bar.
Type 'newreader' into the 'Username' field.
Type 'newreader@example.com' into the 'Email' field.
Type 'Passw0rd!' into the 'Password' field.
Optionally choose an image file in the 'Profile Image (optional)' file field.
Click the 'Register' button.

expected.text: The app navigates to the Login page.
The heading 'Login' is visible.
The registration form is no longer shown.

cases.expectedResult: The app navigates to the Login page. The heading 'Login' is visible. The registration form is no longer shown.
cases.expectedSuccess: The app navigates to the Login page. The heading 'Login' is visible. The registration form is no longer shown.

cases.title: Register User — negative

steps.text: Start from the home page.
Click the 'Register' link in the top navigation bar.
Leave the 'Username', 'Email', and 'Password' fields empty.
Click the 'Register' button.

expected.text: An alert appears with the exact message 'Registration failed. Please try again.'
The page remains on the registration form.
The button text changes to 'Registering...' while the request is in progress and then returns to 'Register' after the failure.

cases.expectedResult: An alert appears with the exact message 'Registration failed. Please try again.' The page remains on the registration form. The button text changes to 'Registering...' while the request is in progress and then returns to 'Register' after the failure.
cases.expectedFailure: An alert appears with the exact message 'Registration failed. Please try again.' The page remains on the registration form. The button text changes to 'Registering...' while the request is in progress and then returns to 'Register' after the failure.

cases.title: Register User — boundary

steps.text: Start from the home page.
Click the 'Register' link in the top navigation bar.
Type a very long username into the 'Username' field.
Type 'a@b.co' into the 'Email' field.
Type a very long password into the 'Password' field.
Do not choose a profile image.
Click the 'Register' button.

expected.text: The form submits without any client-side validation message shown on screen.

If the server rejects the values, an alert appears with the exact message 'Registration failed. Please try again.'
